title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-03-15
source: Source: Soundboard > Reel Master > Cassette > DAT (48k)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording riddled with dropouts and audience splices, yet the show still shines with a cathartic Playin' in the Band and a strong second‑set medley of Truckin', The Other One, Eyes and Stella.
ai_review.review: The performance is regarded as an energetic warm‑up for the following night, highlighted by an inspired Playin' in the Band and a standout second‑set sequence (Truckin' > The Other One > Eyes > Stella). However, the soundboard source suffers from frequent dropouts, volume anomalies and mismatched audience splices that force listeners to edit or tolerate uneven audio quality. Overall the music is enjoyable for fans willing to work around the technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 3‑star ratings, noting decent musical moments but significant recording problems; with limited data the rating reflects an average show hampered by poor audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Numerous dropouts, volume anomalies and audience splices throughout; parts of the first set are missing and the second set required extensive fading and blending, resulting in an uneven listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers view this concert as a warm‑up to the following night’s top‑ten show; the second set is praised for its flow and energy despite technical interruptions.
